output.explanation: This request asks to change data (DELETE rows from marts.fct_orders). I can only write read-only SELECT queries, so I can't run it. Cancelled orders are already left out of revenue because only orders with is_revenue = true (status = 'completed') count. If you want to keep them out of an analysis, filter with WHERE status <> 'cancelled' or WHERE is_revenue. If they really need to be removed from the warehouse, the data engineering team should do that in the dbt models.
